source_reason: Schedule three tutoring sessions in the calendar.可以和create a Google Form 并行
interpretation: 把指定意见落实为报告完成后同时启动表单与日历两个独立external writer。原版已有主agent原生并行，因此不宣称原版没有并行；候选改变的是分支owner与显式依赖。题面“After the report”要求先完成工作簿，邮件必须等待已排课事件的真实回读确认。

changes.original: the main agent must complete this compact four-quiz task directly; do not dispatch sub-agents.
changes.replacement: the main agent owns the CSV analysis, workbook, and final email, then dispatches one wave of exactly two external-workflow-operator sub-agents for the independent form and calendar branches.
changes.explanation: 用两名有外部写入权限的子agent承接指定的并行分支；主agent保留计算、文件和邮件。

changes.original: Start the CSV read, create_form(title="Quiz Improvement Feedback") exactly once, and the three exact calendar searches natively in parallel.
changes.replacement: Do not create the Google Form until this report is complete and its read-back succeeds.
changes.explanation: 为满足原任务After the report的硬约束，把正式Form创建后置；这不是把其他人的意见混入，而是并行候选必须保留的题面依赖。

changes.original: The three event branches are independent and should use native-parallel search/create/read batches.
changes.replacement: The three event branches are independent: use native-parallel search/create/read batches, while keeping search before create and get_event after each retained/created ID.
changes.explanation: 保留原版事件内部原生并行与每个事件的真实先后依赖。

changes.original: Read candidates to verify recipients, send once only if absent, and copy the canonical overall/highest/lowest facts plus all three tutoring titles/dates into the body.
changes.replacement: Do not send a completion summary until the report, form, and all three scheduled events have successful read-backs.
changes.explanation: 新增显式等待，防止邮件将尚未成功创建的课程说成已排课；其余查重和至多一次发送保留。

preserved_requirements: CSV全量按quiz_title分组；分数直接与points_possible/2作严格大于比较。
工作簿两个指定sheet、列名、升序、五项Summary、规定舍入与字面量；总体均分按所有提交计算。
报告完成后创建Quiz Improvement Feedback，三题的题型、选项、必填状态与顺序。
三次2026年3月12/19/26日15:00–17:00课程与确切标题；UTC为题面允许表示。
ccc.instructor@university.edu及确切主题、成绩发现和已排课信息，查重与回读。
qualified_or_unimplemented: 并行从报告成功完成后开始，不能按“可以并行”提前创建Form。
原版本身已有原生并行；本候选是独立子agent职责分离，不把已有并行当成缺失。
assumptions: 将指定人的并行意见及delegation=1解释为允许两个独立external writer；该人没有指定具体agent数量。
plan_summary: 主agent读取CSV，计算并冻结指标，完成并回读工作簿。
一个波次同时派发Form writer和calendar writer，二者各自唯一拥有对应外部资源。
主agent可并行查Sent，等待真实事件及Form回读后再发送结果邮件并最终核验。
expected_tradeoff: 两个独立外部writer可能缩短报告后的外部操作耗时，但增加派发和交接成本；是否优于原生并行需实验验证。
